projects.name: Gemini-Discord-Bot
projects.summary: Google Gemini Discord bot with multimodal understanding (text, images, videos, audio, PDFs, and office/code files), Gemini tools (Google Search, URL Context, Code Execution), and a lot of settings.
projects.description: Production-grade Discord AI bot with over 100 stars on GitHub. Leverages Gemini Flash to deliver streaming multimodal intelligence across Discord servers, with session memory management, Google Search grounding, Python code sandbox execution, and Nano Banana support.

screenshots.caption: Gemini tools - code execution prompt and code

architecture: Clear rules: channel first, then server, then you
Safe memory: only new changes saved, no mix-ups
Live answers: stop button, auto retry, big replies as files
Same safety checks on every button
Clean start: right order every time, no double setup
features: Discord chat via mention, DM, auto-reply
Live answers with Stop, long answers as files
Separate chats: create, switch, clear, delete
Custom personalities for user, server, channel
Image / video / file / YouTube reading + Google search + file creation

projects.name: Gemini-Live-discord
projects.summary: Discord bot that joins a voice channel, streams user speech to Gemini Live, and plays Gemini's streaming audio replies back into the same channel
projects.description: Discord bot joins voice channels and streams audio bidirectionally with Gemini Live API. It decodes/mixes Discord Opus to 16kHz mono for Gemini and re-encodes 24kHz Gemini output to 48kHz stereo for Discord playback. Slash commands control per-guild sessions with auto-reconnect, VAD, and interruption handling.

screenshots.caption: The Discord board being connected to a voice command.

architecture: Modular audio / voice / bridge / gemini separation
CPer-guild isolated bridge sessions
Exponential-backoff reconnect with degraded mode
Validated env-driven tunable configuration
features: Live Discord-Gemini voice bridging
/join, /leave, /reset slash commands
Multi-user frame mixing with speaker labels
Local + server barge-in interruption

projects.name: opendroid_remote
projects.summary: Browser-only Android remote-control and gaming client via WebUSB ADB and scrcpy, no companion app, backend, or telemetry, all stays in browser
projects.description: It mirrors Android video/audio into a Chromium canvas and injects keyboard, mouse, touch, and clipboard input back. It pushes a verified scrcpy server over WebUSB ADB, decodes with WebCodecs/WebAudio, and layers visual game mapping with local profiles.

screenshots.caption: Streaming Granny from an Android phone to a Chromebook, with full key mapping support
Streaming Minecraft from an Android phone to a Chromebook with native mouse input support

architecture: WebUSB ADB multi-device connect and auto-reconnect
Scrcpy H.264/H.265/AV1 video plus PCM/Opus/AAC/FLAC audio
Physical UHID mouse, touch, keyboard, clipboard control
Visual game mapping with joystick, swipe, mouse-look
features: Layered ADB / scrcpy / capabilities / input / UI separation
Serialized session lifecycle with codec fallback retries
Resolution-independent contain-fit coordinate transforms
Injectable mapping engine with isolated touch allocation
Local-first IndexedDB credential, profile, settings stores

projects.name: HTML-previewer
projects.summary: A streamlined, local-first frontend playground to build, organize, and preview full web projects directly in your browser.
projects.description: Browser-only workspace for creating and organizing HTML, CSS, JS, and media files with CodeMirror editing and file-tree management. Renders via virtual filesystem, asset-to-blob URL rewriting, and injected runtime shims inside a sandboxed iframe with modal, docked, and new-tab targets plus postMessage console capture.

screenshots.caption: Split-screen workflow allowing code editing while viewing real-time updates and logs alongside the editor.
Manage complex multi-file projects with hierarchical directory structures, file operations, and batch actions.
Full modal preview with an integrated developer console supporting log, info, warn, and error outputs with filtering.

architecture: Modular single-responsibility class separation
Cached virtual-filesystem path resolution
Host-mirrored injected preview runtime shims
Tracked blob-URL lifecycle with error fallbacks
features: Multi-file/folder workspace with CodeMirror editors
Live sandboxed preview in modal/docked/new-tab
Built-in console with filtering and counts
ZIP/folder/file import and ZIP export
Persistent customizable editor settings and shortcuts

projects.summary: A Manifest V3 Chrome extension that brings YouTube's mobile experience to desktop, with desktop-friendly playback controls, background playback support, and feed/watch-page layout fixes.

Keyboard controls + 300% WebAudio volume boost

projects.summary: Browser-based Markdown editor rendering to styled HTML via Marked, KaTeX, and Prism. Uses iframe srcdoc preview builder, library/history.

Centralized CONFIG constants
Math preserve-restore pipeline
Isolated iframe page builder

projects.name: industrial-lyrics
projects.summary: A client-side 3D industrial/neon-themed synchronized lyrics visualizer that renders LRC lyrics as animated steel panels with glowing neon text synced to audio playback.
projects.description: Users drag-and-drop an audio file and an LRC lyrics file, and the app renders each lyric line as a rusted steel plate with flickering neon text, mechanical armatures, sparks, and atmospheric dust — all in WebGL via Three.js. It supports word-level timing, procedural PBR textures, and exports to MP4/WebM video.

screenshots.caption: Each lyric line is rendered on a textured 3D panel that lights up in sync with the audio.
The Visual Configurator lets you set a custom background image and fine-tune its darkness and blur.
The export dialog renders the synchronized 3D scene and audio directly to a video file at 30 or 60 FPS, up to 1080p.

architecture: Clean 4-layer separation: domain lib (zero deps), types, Three.js scene, DOM UI
Pervasive memory optimization: object pooling, scratch vectors, geometry caching, disposal chains
Strict TypeScript with comprehensive type safety
Procedural texture generation eliminates external asset dependencies
features: Dual-mesh neon word rendering with 4-state glow machine
Procedural rust/crack PBR textures (no external texture assets)
WebCodecs MP4 + MediaRecorder WebM dual export pipeline
Binary-search O(log n) lyric sync engine with interpolated audio time
Instrumental pause panels with filling progress tube and bubble particles

journal.title: Still Learning to Be an Engineer
journal.meta: Riddhiman Kundal • 1st Year Student • COE • Thapar University

entries.title: OHH.. WHOOoo Is HEE ?!
entries.content: I'm riddhiman, someone interested in thinking creatively and finding solid solutions to real world problems, and building tools that make people's lives better. I started back in 2018, writing HTML code on my phone's notes app. Since then, I've learned a lot, and I'm still learning. What began as a personal interest has grown into a journey toward making it my profession.

entries.title: What more have I done?
entries.content: I don't upload everything to GitHub. I've also built Android apps (a birthday reminder and a markdown viewer), a Windows app (a simple, well optimized tool, around 650 lines of code, that remaps my laptop's Copilot key to do something else, it's fully customizable), a YOLO based computer vision AI model that detects pipe leakage from a live camera feed, and a cute, complete 3D multiplayer birthday racing game. I've even run AI locally, on my phone, using Ollama, entirely offline.

entries.title: Life Right Now :'<
entries.content: It's hard right now. Stressful. Seriously. I've never seen this many people at once, and there's a lot of work. I'm an introvert, and all of this is so overwhelming. I'm not able to do anything properly. My studies aren't going well at all, and I really hope I adapt and do better. I'm not getting time for anything, and I'm really not used to this. But I'm trying. I hope it works out.

journal.quote: “Make it efficient. Make it stable. Make it natural.”
